mathematical_assessment.assessment: For a noiseless finite sum y[n]=sum(a_j*z_j^n) with distinct exponential poles and enough samples, Hankel columns span the Vandermonde subspace. Its one-row shifts satisfy U2=U1*Phi up to basis similarity, so eigenvalues of the least-squares shift can estimate z_j. This requires the chosen rank to represent the relevant signal subspace, U1 full column rank, and a sufficiently stationary exponential model. The implementation constructs the Hankel overlap correctly and obtains frequency from arg(z)*fs/(stride*2pi), with decay log|z|/stride. Positive-angle selection retains one conjugate half, not an amplitude/observability proof.

Downsampling is raw stride selection without an anti-alias filter. Estimated frequencies are principal sampled frequencies; eigenvalue phase alone does not identify the original full-rate branch. Powers-of-two stride agreement does not eliminate aliases. For example,11304.2923Hz equals11025+279.2923 and aliases279.2923Hz at strides4,8and16. Packet explicitly requires alias/nuisance/mode-identity validation before normative use and does not claim alias exclusion, so this is a future gate, not a required R1 correction.

Membrane historical context has70active modes; a real70-pair exponential response can require rank140 before additional nuisances, while experiments use80/100/120. These are analyst truncations, not established true order. Weak singular gaps, nonnormal eigenvalue sensitivity and extra growing/nearby fitted poles prevent treating a repeated cluster as a calibrated modal estimate. Reviewer conditioning measurements below independently support this caution. Greater rank is not automatically better; rank120 improves one candidate frequency while worsening overall shift conditioning/residual.

Full-record and split-window shifts are materially different. Full-window matched physical apertures show the279.2923 cluster at higher ranks, whereas weaker ranks/short-aperture variants drift. Finite capture, quantized iterative state, multimode beating, omitted components and possible nonstationarity are not separated causally. No record establishes stationary model adequacy, noise distribution, reliable rank selection or an uncertainty interval.

No static center enters the SVD or eigensystem; broad display frequency intervals are applied only after fitting. However, README mode-specific ranges are reconstructed by choosing the post-fit candidate nearest the historical static center, especially when mode3 has extra nearby poles. That is a labeling/selection rule, not independent physical mode identification. The full pole lists and unstable-mode3 limitation are retained, so no hidden grade follows. Any future procedure must explicitly freeze candidate selection, missing/duplicate-pole rules and calibration before using it as an oracle.

The five-tone fixture checks implementation on an exact small, well-separated, common-decay synthetic exponential sum, and recovers its tones to numerical precision. It does not calibrate a70-mode quantized capture, dynamic range, nearby nuisance poles, model error or decimation. Successful variant spread is neither a confidence interval nor an allowed device tolerance. Hankel entries reuse samples, so ordinary independent-noise uncertainty would also require justification. Packet states these limits explicitly.

The old released eligibility condition compares reference estimate/static pole center within1e-4. It is distinct from the analyzer's model-estimator-bias clean-mode selection. Classification168/4/2 is accurate and descriptive, not causal. Membrane mode1 has7.06732254Hz requested cutoff and20591uncapped FIR taps versus4001cap and12288post-impulse samples; model/reference old estimates moving together toward261.624 supports an isolation/neighbor-contamination hypothesis, not proof that the cap alone caused it.

Existing retained data support a bounded candidate observation route near279.2923 in both channels, plus robust low-pitch0/1 estimated offsets relative to historical centers. They do not yet identify a validated full-rate modal frequency with uncertainty, explain coefficient rounding or tuning, resolve mode3 orA1, grade any of174omissions, relax1e-4, prove arm64 behavior, or establish a required-outcome numerator.
